mission: Veraine on stage — full philosophy delivered. Sera's firsthand counter-argument. Kael's seduction. Torin's dangerous quiet.
conflict: Ben vs. Veraine — ideology, not combat. Her argument is coherent enough to be genuinely unsettling.
setting: Rendezvous point in the Outer Rim — neutral space
notes:
Time: Days before reaching Veranthos
Thematic beat: The story takes the antagonist seriously — Ben must answer her best argument, not a straw man
Original scene_outcome: Veraine departs without violence. Group dynamics shifted — Torin heard his own thoughts articulated, Kael felt the pull of recognition. Hours later: the seal lurches. Veraine used the truce to deliver sabotage.
pov_arc_phase: Attack — the counter-argument at full strength
